page.layout: Running head across the top, full width. Left column: alphabetical index entries from "Defperatorum" through "Echinus", ending with the letters "E" and "E" initial. Right column, beside the top of the left column: two entries ("Elifichnia" and "Emptio"). No page number, catchword or signature on this part.; One column of alphabetical index entries on the right, with the letter F as a heading partway down; no other blocks, margins or notes.

Eranus, inopia Latini sermonis dictum à Plinio & Traiano. 276.7. Eranorum finis. 275.20

page.notes: Left column is the main index column; the two right-hand entries sit beside its top only. Doubtful readings: the Greek after "Diuitum" (ἀπεσία), the Greek in "Dombs eruditis" (ἱππο-τρόφους), the Greek after "curam μ-" (κεγλόγων), and the lower part of the "Echinus" entry, which is only partly visible. "Feruis" is read as the long-s form "seruis", printed as "servis". Greek word in the Ethologia entry is uncertain (accent and final letters); marked [?]. The F drop initial is joined to Abulari as printed.
